content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NTH Director Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: consumeraffairs.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date mentioned in the official notification. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Test House (NTH) under the Department of Consumer Affairs for the post of Director in Mumbai.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Director post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Director position at the National Test House through this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary structure for the Director post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Director position will receive a salary in Level-13, ranging from Rs. 1,23,100 to Rs. 2,15,900 per month.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for NTH Director Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is offline. Candidates must send a hard copy of their application through the proper channel along with an email copy.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Master's Degree in Chemistry or Physics or a Degree in Engineering, Metallurgy, Textile, or Rubber Technology from a recognized university or institute.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any work experience required for this role?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates need 12 years of experience in a managerial capacity in the field of testing and evaluation of materials, along with related laboratory knowledge.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q8. What documents need to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach attested copies of their last 5 years' APARs, Vigilance Clearance, No Penalty Statement, Integrity Certificate, and Cadre Clearance.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the completed application be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to the Under Secretary, Department of Consumer Affairs, 12/2, Jam Nagar House, Shahjahan Road, New Delhi-110011.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a deputation-based government job opportunity where the appointment period ordinarily will not exceed four years.
